text:
Kei: quick follow-up from today's all-hands about headcount playbook and internal mobility. TL;DR: prioritize internal moves, carve out infra/SRE/customer roles, new external reqs need biz-case. drop edge cases here.

Ruth: Does this mean teams should stop external sourcing immediately?

People Ops: Not immediately for Priority=1 roles. For others, set Greenhouse tag to `hold_external` and pause paid outreach. We'll publish a short tagging script.

VP Eng: Priority=1 = infra, SRE, product-security, revenue-impacting customer roles. Also any role supporting committed enterprise deals.

Kei: For managers with open reqs mid-interview stage, what to do if candidate is final-round?

People Ops: If final-stage and role maps to Priority=1, continue. If not, pause external offers but honor any signed offers. Mark the req `pause_post-final` so Recruiting knows status.

Hiring Coord: Internal transfers — will interview slots be reserved?

People Ops: Yes. Recruiting will fast-track internal candidates and reserve one interview slot per week for prioritized internal moves. Label candidates `internal_transfer`.

Ruth: Contractor conversions? we have a contractor on infra doing 50% on-call.

Finance: Conversions allowed only if net run-rate improves or role is mission-critical. Submit conversion form with 3-month cost delta. Expect 72h review.

Kei: Any temporary pools to cover gaps?

VP Eng: Creating a 6-person "flex stability" pool to deploy for 4-8 week backfills and incident coverage. Staffing from existing approved headcount. Teams can request deployment via People Ops.

People Ops: Manager immediate checklist: 1) tag reqs in Greenhouse (`org-pri` / `hold_external` / `internal_transfer`); 2) attach 1-paragraph biz case for any external req >L4; 3) flag contractor conversions with cost template. Office hours 10am tomorrow for walkthrough.

Recruiting Bot: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/headcount-playbook-2026 (internal) snapshot=1998765400

Kei: thanks all. If you have unique situations (promotions tied to hires, critical EMEA roles), DM People Ops and cc your org head so we can triage quickly.

Ruth: appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
